Author: Raj Beer Singh

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:9453
Court No. - 65
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 55510 of 2023

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Adarsh Bhushan,Abhay Singh Tomar,Sushant
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 656 of 2023 under Sections 376, 323, 504, 506, 452 IPC, Police Station Hata, District Kushi Nagar, with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.

In the first information report it was alleged by the prosecutrix that her husband is residing in Mumbai and that on 17.8.2023 at 9.00 p.m., applicant armed with a knife trespassed into her house and committed rape upon her.
Learned counsel submitted that the incident has been shown of 17.8.2023 but first information report has been lodged after about one and a half month of incident, on 6.10.2023.
No explanation for long delay in first information report has been shown.
There is nothing to show that prosecutrix has raised any alarm.
She has not sustained any injury.
Victim is 30 years old major and married lady.

Referring to statement of victim Shoiab Alam @ Sheru vs State Of U.P. on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13133281/
1 and all attending facts, it was submitted that victim had been a consenting party and she has lodged first information report with long delay with mala fide intention.

entities.text: Shoiab Alam @ Sheru vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Lastly it was submitted that applicant accused is languishing in jail since 07.10.2023 having no criminal history.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the application and submitted that prosecutrix has made clear allegation that applicant has committed rape upon her.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, the period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Shoiab Alam alias Sheru, involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 17.1.2024 Kumar Manish.
